title: Research experience
description: content/data/research-experience.json: research positions. Not rendered as a page section at the moment; used in llms-full.txt (when features.experience is on). Array of entries.

organization.description: Company, lab or university. Shown under the logo (use this key, not "company").

start.description: Start date. Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

end.description: End date, or "Present". Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

image.description: Logo (shown as a circle). Path of an image under public/, starting with "/" (e.g. "/images/lab-logo.png"). Rendered with next/image, so remote URLs and paths without the leading slash break the page. Defaults to /images/placeholder.png.

description.description: What you did. Each line (separated by \n) becomes a bullet; an empty string shows "In progress". Required: llms-full.txt print it, and the Experience component crashes without it. Must be a string, not an array.

links.description: Buttons shown under the entry: an object mapping the button label to its URL, e.g. {"GitHub": "https://...", "Paper": "https://..."}. Labels containing preprint/paper/code/github/demo/slides/video/poster/website get matching icons.

additionalProperties.description: URL (absolute, or a path under public/ such as /assets/slides.pdf).

collaborators.description: People you worked with, shown as "Collaborators: A, B" with links.

link.description: Link to their homepage or profile (optional).

show_on_website.description: Not read for research-experience.json yet: these entries currently appear only in llms-full.txt.

show_in_resume.description: Not read for research-experience.json (the resume generator does not include this file).

show_in_resume_short.description: Not read for research-experience.json (the resume generator does not include this file).
